faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for WCD Odisha Anganwadi Helper Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Anganwadi Helper posts is 18 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in WCD Odisha Anganwadi Helper Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Anganwadi Helper post in the Women and Child Development Department Odisha recruitment drive. These positions are for Anganwadi Helper (Female).

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for WCD Odisha Anganwadi Helper posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Anganwadi Helper posts is online. Interested candidates must submit their applications through the official website of WCD Odisha or the provided direct link.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for Anganwadi Helper posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Anganwadi Helper posts must have passed the 10th class from a recognized board. This is the minimum educational qualification required for these positions.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for WCD Odisha Anganwadi Helper Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Anganwadi Helper posts. Candidates can apply without paying any charges.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for Anganwadi Helper in WCD Odisha?
faq.answer: The selection process for Anganwadi Helper posts includes Document Verification followed by the preparation of a Merit List. Candidates will be selected based on their eligibility and performance.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the Anganwadi Helper posts be located?
faq.answer: The Anganwadi Helper posts are located in Balangir, Odisha. Candidates selected for these positions will be deployed in Anganwadi centers within the Balangir district.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website for WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official website for WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026 is http://engagement-awc-odisha.gov.in. Candidates can visit this portal for detailed information and to apply online.

faq.question: Q9. Can male candidates apply for Anganwadi Helper posts?
faq.answer: No, the Anganwadi Helper posts are specifically for female candidates, as indicated in the vacancy details. Only eligible female applicants can apply for these positions.

faq.answer: The official notification for WCD Odisha Anganwadi Helper Recruitment 2026 was released on 01 September 2025. Candidates should refer to this notification for all crucial details.
